blocks.text: Khoon ke daurani nizam ke ilawa insanon mein maddon ki naqal ka ek aur nizam hai, jo tissues se maddey khoon ko bhi lautata hai: lymphatic system. Yeh lymph vessels, lymphoid masses, lymph nodes aur lymph, is nizam mein behne wale mayah, par mushtamil hai.

Lymphatic system chhoti naliyon, lymph capillaries, se shuru hota hai, jin ke band sire extracellular (interstitial) fluid mein hote hain. Interstitial fluid ka dabao use lymph capillaries mein dhakelta hai, jo blood capillaries se zyada permeable hain, to bare molecules bhi dakhil ho sakte hain. Jab interstitial fluid lymph capillaries mein aata hai to use lymph kehte hain. Lymph capillaries mil kar bari lymphatic vessels (lymphatics ya lymph vessels) banati hain, jo mil kar bari lymph ducts banati hain. Do bari lymph ducts hain, right lymphatic duct aur thoracic duct, jo tarteeb-war daen aur baen subclavian veins (jo bazuon aur kandhon se khoon dil tak le jati hain) mein khulti hain. Lymph ka bahao hamesha jism ke tissues se thoracic duct ki taraf hai; yeh skeletal muscles ki sargarmi, viscera ki harkat aur saans ki harkaton se qaim rehta hai, aur lymph vessels ke valves wapsi rokte hain.

blocks.alt: Gol tissue cells ke darmiyan baen taraf surkh arteriole aur daen taraf neeli venule blood capillaries ke jaal se jure hain. Hari, band siron wali lymph capillaries blood capillaries ke beech se guzarti hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Blood capillaries se rasne wala mayah (interstitial fluid) jab lymph capillaries mein dakhil ho jaye to lymph kehlata hai. Lymph capillaries ka ek sira band (blind) hota hai.

blocks.title: Yaad-dehani: lacteals
blocks.text: Villi mein lymph capillaries ki shakhein lacteals hain. Fatty acids aur glycerol villi ke epithelial cells mein jazb hote hain, jahan woh triglycerides banate hain; triglycerides proteins se dhak kar chylomicrons banate hain, jo villi ke lacteals mein jate hain.

blocks.alt: Insani jism jis ke sar, baazuon, dhar aur tangon mein lymphatic vessels chalti hain aur gardan, baghal (armpits) aur ran (groin) mein lymph nodes ke guchhe hain. Right lymphatic duct right subclavian vein mein aur thoracic duct aorta ke saath oopar ja kar left subclavian vein mein khulti hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Lymph aakhir kaar khoon mein wapas jati hai: jism ke daen oopri hisse ki lymph right lymphatic duct se, baqi sab thoracic duct se.

Lymphatic nizam zaid mayah aur hal shuda proteins aur doosre maddey khoon ko lautata hai. Ausat shakhs mein har din qareeb teen litre zyada mayah blood capillaries se nikalta hai jitna un mein lautta hai, magar yeh lymphatic capillaries se jazb ho kar khoon ke dil mein dakhil hone se pehle bloodstream mein lautaya jata hai. Lymphatic nizam jism ko ajnabi hamla-awaron se bachane mein bhi madad karta hai: lymph nodes lymph ko chhante (filter) hain, aur un ke lymphocytes aur macrophages us mein maujood bacteria aur viruses ko tabah karte hain. Tilli (spleen) apne macrophages aur lymphocytes se khoon chhanti hai, jo ajnabi zarrat aur purane RBCs tabah karte hain, aur RBCs zakheera bhi karti hai.

Kuch maqamat par lymph vessels mein connective tissue ke lothre hain jin mein lymphocytes maujood hain: lymph nodes. Kai afferent lymph vessels ek lymph node mein dakhil hoti hain aur lymph ek efferent lymph vessel se nikalti hai. Lymph nodes gardan, baghal (axilla) aur jaanghon ke joru (groin) mein maujood hain. Is ke ilawa kai lymphoid masses mukhtalif jagahon par hain, maslan alimentary canal ki mucosa aur submucosa mein; bare lymphoid masses tilli, thymus, tonsils aur adenoids hain, aur yeh lymphocytes banate hain.

blocks.title: Sooje hue lymph nodes
blocks.text: Kuch beemariyon, maslan kan-pere (mumps), mein lymph nodes ki dardnak soojan zyada tar murda lymphocytes aur macrophages ke jama hone ka nateeja hai.

blocks.alt: Gol lymph node jis ka hara capsule lymphocytes aur macrophages ke khanon ko gherta hai. Kinare par kai lymph vessels (lymphatics) lymph andar late hain; oopar ek lymph vessel lymph ko bahar le jati hai, aur saath khoon ki naliyon ka jora hai jahan se khoon aata aur jata hai.

blocks.text: Kai afferent vessels lymph andar late hain magar ek hi efferent vessel bahar le jati hai, is liye lymph aahista guzarti hai aur macrophages jaraseem ko khatam kar lete hain.

blocks.explanation: Blood capillaries interstitial fluid tissues mein risati rehti hain, aur zaid aam taur par lymph capillaries mein jata aur skeletal muscles ke sukar, viscera ki harkat aur saans se valve wali lymph vessels mein oopar dhakela jata hai. Khara rehna taangon ka muscle pump hata deta hai, to takhnon se lymph ka bahao sust ho jata hai, zaid mayah subclavian veins ko kafi jaldi nahin lautta, aur tissues mein soojan ke taur par jama ho jata hai.

items: Lymphatic nizam (lymph vessels, lymphoid masses, lymph nodes aur lymph) zaid tissue fluid aur proteins khoon ko lautata aur hamla-awaron se bachata hai.

Interstitial fluid band, permeable lymph capillaries mein lymph ke taur par jata hai; valve wali naliyan right lymphatic duct aur thoracic duct tak le jati hain, jo subclavian veins mein khulti hain; pathe, viscera aur saans bahao chalate hain. Villi ke lacteals chylomicrons le jate hain.

Lymph nodes (gardan, axilla, groin; kai afferent, ek efferent nali) lymphocytes aur macrophages se lymph chhante hain; tilli khoon chhanti, purane RBCs tabah karti aur RBCs zakheera karti hai; tilli, thymus, tonsils, adenoids aur aant ke lothre lymphocytes banate hain.
